title: Sweet and Sour Tofu Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Veggies and Steamed Rice
description: Stir-fries make for easy, speedy weeknight dinners – and they usually include lots of veggies, so that's a big thumbs-up too! This recipe serves up smoky barbecue-flavoured tofu, onion and capsicum in a moreish sweet and sour sauce.

steps.text: Cook rice: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with 310ml (1¼ cups) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 13 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins.
Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, cut the onion and capsicums into 3cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Quarter the tofu pieces (see Kitchen 101).
Warm tofu: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Remove from the pan.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over high heat. Add the onion and stir-fry for 1 min, then add the capsicum and garlic and stir-fry for 2-3 mins until the veggies are tender but still with crunch.

Serve up: Add the tofu, sweet and sour sauce and 2 tbs water to the veggies and stir-fry for 30 secs or until warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the rice and stir-fry among bowls and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Want to know the secrets to stir-fry perfection? Have your tofu and veggies prepped and ready to go before you start cooking. And fast and hot is key: make sure you stir-fry the veggies over high heat, stirring constantly so they cook evenly. We've used a deep frypan, but you can use a wok if you have one.
